name: officer-kit
description: Tools for what a Marine officer does every week: read and review orders; write awards, fitness reports, recommendations and correspondence; run a reporting senior profile; build promotion and recognition packages and board briefs; counsel; build risk assessments, range packages and training schedules; run investigations and property loss inquiries; prepare for inspections; plan, teach and study. Blind reviewers and a lessons loop make it yours. Method only, never your data.
